recipe.visualDefinition: A dark navy blue celestial field featuring a large, arched custom-lettered title with a vibrant orange-to-yellow gradient, accented by white stars and a thin orange border with curved corner flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: The arched title follows the curve of the central flourish below it.
The warm gradient of the text contrasts sharply against the cool navy background.
The thin orange border echoes the top-most color of the text gradient.
Small white stars provide a rhythmic texture across the dark negative space.
coreInvariants: Navy blue background with subtle airbrushed texture
Orange-to-yellow vertical gradient within the main lettering
Arched baseline for the primary display text
Thin orange line border with inward-curving corner details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary title is centered and occupies the middle horizontal third of the frame, scaled to dominate the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant display lettering acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright lettering, follows the arch downward to the flourishes, and then moves to the smaller subtitle at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark navy space at the top and bottom creates a sense of depth and cosmic scale.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and orange (text fill and border)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation text pops against a low-value, desaturated background.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stems are thick with a slight taper
Terminals are flared and pointed, reminiscent of Victorian wood-type
The entire word is set on an upward arch
Letters feature a thick blue drop shadow that blends into the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'h' and 'l' have notched, flag-like tops
The 'i' dots are perfect circles in orange
The 'w' is constructed of two overlapping 'v' shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, custom-drawn display face paired with a clean, functional slab-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the flared terminals and heavy vertical weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark navy blue background with a subtle airbrushed texture. Add a thin orange border line near the edges with inward-curving arcs at the corners. Scatter small, sharp white five-pointed stars across the field. In the center, include a large blue curvilinear flourish with a thick stroke.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main display text in an arched path over the flourish using a custom flared serif. Use a vertical gradient from orange at the top to yellow at the bottom. Add a thin white inner stroke and a heavy navy drop shadow. Place the subtitle in a white slab-serif font at the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the gradient vertical (orange to yellow)?
Are the corner flourishes present on the border?
Is the background a textured navy blue?

mustRedesign: Do not use the exact name 'Chilliwack'
Ensure the star pattern is randomized
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text gradient is smooth and not banded.
Verify the border corners curve inward, not outward.
Ensure the blue shadow of the text is distinct from the background.
Confirm the subtitle is legible against the dark field.
recipe.reuseFormula: Navy field + Arched Gradient Lettering + Victorian Flourish + Starry Texture = Retro Rock Aesthetic
